roam.share.photoPermissionDenied.en: Allow this app to add photos in Settings, then return and retry saving.
roam.share.photoPermissionDenied.zh-Hans: 请在设置中允许本应用添加照片，返回后重试保存。

roam.share.photoPermissionRestricted.en: Saving photos is restricted on this device. Retry after the restriction is removed.
roam.share.photoPermissionRestricted.zh-Hans: 此设备限制了照片保存。限制解除后可重试。

roam.share.photoSaveUnavailable.en: Photo saving is not configured in this app build. You can still use the system share sheet.
roam.share.photoSaveUnavailable.zh-Hans: 当前应用版本尚未配置相册保存，仍可使用系统分享。

roam.share.photoSaveFailed.en: The card could not be saved. Retry saving the prepared card.
roam.share.photoSaveFailed.zh-Hans: 足迹卡保存失败，可重试保存已生成的卡片。

roam.share.photoSaveSourceChanged.en: This saved walk changed or is no longer readable. Close this card and reopen the walk to prepare a new one.
roam.share.photoSaveSourceChanged.zh-Hans: 这条漫游记录已更改或暂时无法读取。请关闭足迹卡，重新打开记录并生成新卡片。
